fact: AGP reports that at 2 July 2025 about ten facilities were in the pilot phase of eGabon-SIS, launched in February 2024: the health centres of London, Glass, Nzeng-Ayong and Owendo, the military hospitals of Akanda and PK9, the CHU d'Owendo and CHU Mère & Enfants, and the Sino-Gabonese and Egypto-Gabonese cooperation hospitals.
title: Gabon / Digitalisation du système de santé : dix structures hospitalières déjà en immersion
